project(bytes32,uint32,uint32,uint32,int.details: The gate that ownership exists for: only the session's owner may advance it. In      the companion project any address could call `start` and delete an in-flight      generation, because the state was global and unguarded.

registerModel(uint256,address,(uint16,ui.details: Immutability is the point rather than a simplification. If a registered model      could be repointed, every hash previously published against it would become a      claim about something that no longer exists, and the provenance guarantee would      be worth nothing. A new model takes a new id.

verifyWeights(uint256).details: Cheap enough to call before relying on an output. Weights held as contract code      cannot in fact be altered in place, so this guards against the registry      pointing somewhere the caller did not expect rather than against mutation.

project(bytes32,uint32,uint32,uint32,int.notice: Run one projection for a session, reading weights from the registered model.

projectStateless(uint256,uint32,uint32,u.notice: Matmul against a registered model without a session, for reads and probing.

registerModel(uint256,address,(uint16,ui.notice: Register a model. Immutable once written.

startSession(bytes32,uint256).notice: Begin a generation. The caller owns it.

verifyWeights(uint256).notice: Confirm a model's weights are still the ones registered.
